Best restaurant in Nha Trang
Aug 2026 • Family
Bypassed many restaurants, but there is no better "Little Armenia"!!!! We went on vacation with three families with children, it is very difficult to feed the children, but in this restaurant found dishes delicious for all tastes and ages. Insanely delicious dumplings for a little daughter, awesome mushroom cream soup for an older daughter, fish for seafood enthusiasts and, of course, amazing lyulas for men! A very hospitable and welcoming welcome, with care for every guest!!! Live music is a special highlight of this restaurant, music on demand! Eating, drinking and dancing, posh holidays. Thank you very much, we will be back in Vietnam, it is mandatory to have dinner only in Little Armenia!

Always great
Jul 2024 • Family
Have eaten here for years and it was always great. Last time however I had to write them a less then blowing review because they were trying to charge a 20% VAT when they do not have such a license. However, they no longer charge the tax. We asked before we ate. As usual the meal was superb . The service great. They still charge a 5% fee if you use a credit card. I own a restaurant and will never understand why anyone charges a fee. Accepting credit cards just bring you a lot more business because tourist get charged huge fees at ATM’s far more then a business is charged for credit cards. We put a fraction of the fee we must pay on every menu item. But we do not mention charging any fee anymore they we say how much we pay for beef or any other service we provide . So just be aware. If you use a credit card they will charge you 5%. Hopefully someday they will change that . For me I can swallow a price for a meal 5 vnd more and no mention of the fee then I can a business telling me they are charging more .

Hidden gem in Nha Trang
Jun 2024 • Family
Love this restaurant! My family and I stayed in Nha Trang for a month, and this became our go-to spot. Chef Ashot truly cooks with love, and it shows in every dish. The flavors are authentic and delicious, bringing a delightful Armenian twist to the local culinary scene.

We never imagined finding such a fantastic Armenian restaurant in Vietnam, but we're so glad we did. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, making it perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. Each visit felt like a culinary adventure, with dishes that were both comforting and exciting.

If you're in Nha Trang, don't miss out on this hidden gem. Chef Ashot's passion for cooking is evident, and every meal is a memorable experience.
